## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] `uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] A line under **Unreleased** in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Docs or a recipe updated, if users see the change
- [ ] New dependencies are optional extras, and their licence is noted
- [ ] No secrets, private data, model weights or videos in the diff
